import pytest
from rich.console import Console, ConsoleOptions, Measurement

def test_double_width_character_measurement():
    # Create a console with a specific width
    console = Console(width=20)
    
    # Create a string with double-width characters
    double_width_str = "日本語"
    
    # Measure the string
    measurement = Measurement.get(console, console.options, double_width_str)
    
    # Check if the measurement is correct
    assert measurement.minimum == 6, "Double-width character measurement is incorrect"
    assert measurement.maximum == 6, "Double-width character measurement is incorrect"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_double_width_character_measurement()
